name: Northshore Studio
tagline: Sound, light and staging for live events.
description: Northshore Studio provides sound, lighting and stage production for concerts, festivals and private events.

home.headline: Shows that sound as good as they look.
home.intro: From a 50-person rooftop to a 5,000-capacity field, we bring the rig, the crew and the plan.

highlights.title: One crew, start to finish
highlights.text: Site visit, load-in, show and load-out by the same team.

highlights.title: Gear we own
highlights.text: No rental surprises. We maintain every speaker and light we bring.

highlights.title: Clear pricing
highlights.text: A written quote within two working days.

about.headline: About us
paragraphs: Northshore Studio started in 2015 as two engineers and a van. Today we run production for venues and promoters across the region.
We care about the details your audience never notices: clean power, safe rigging and a quiet changeover.

items.title: Live sound
items.text: PA systems, monitors and engineers for any size of show.

items.title: Lighting
items.text: Stage wash, moving heads and a programmed show.

items.title: Staging
items.text: Modular stages, risers and barricades, installed and inspected.

contact.headline: Contact
contact.intro: Tell us the date, the venue and the size of the crowd. We reply within one working day.
